placements.frame: what must the pipeline do when a submission arrives without an explicit id, and through what mechanisms does it discharge that obligation?
placements.why: Both expressions concern the same thematic subject: the pipeline's responsibility to produce an identifier from memory content when no explicit id field is supplied. src-1 reports the absence; src-2 prescribes the remedy — slug generation via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback, then successful file commit. This is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (id handling, slug generation, fallback mechanisms), not a one-time fact. No existing leaf holds it.
